name: Kalista
title: the Spear of Vengeance

Q.name: Pierce
Q.description: Kalista hurls a spear, dealing 10/75/140/205/270 + 1.05×AD physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying any Rend stacks to the next target hit. Kalista can dash after using this Ability using Martial Poise.
Q.summary: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

W.name: Sentinel
W.description: Passive: When Kalista and her Oathsworn both Attack the same target, she deals 10/12/14.0/16/18% max Health magic damage. This effect has a 10 second Cooldown per target and a cap of 100/125/150/175/200 to non-champions. Active: Kalista sends a ghost to patrol an area for three laps. Champions spotted are revealed for 4 seconds. This ability has 2 charges (90/80/70/60/50 second refresh).
W.summary: Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target. Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.

E.name: Rend
E.description: Passive: Kalista's spears linger in their target for 4 seconds, stacking any number of times. Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing 5/15/25/35/45 + 0.7×AD + 0.65×AP plus 7/14/21/28/35 + 0.2/0.275/0.35/0.425/0.5×AD + 0.5×AP physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by 0.1/0.18/0.26/0.34/0.42 + 0.001×AP for 2 seconds. If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds 10/15/20/25/30 Mana.
E.summary: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.

R.name: Fate's Call
R.description: Kalista puts her Oathsworn into Stasis and draws them to herself for up to 4 seconds. The Oathsworn can click to launch themselves, stopping at the first champion hit and Knocking Back all nearby enemies. If the Oathsworn hits a champion, they are placed at their maximum attack range from it.
R.summary: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.

Passive.name: Martial Poise
Passive.description: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.
Passive.summary: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Lane-dominant marksman who hops after every attack and stacks spears in targets for an E Rend execute. Wins early with bot priority and objective control, using R to throw her Oathsworn support into fights.
strengths: Hops after each attack (Martial Poise): kites and dodges skillshots while trading
E Rend: ramping damage + slow, executes minions/monsters for drake and baron control
R saves her Oathsworn (stasis) or throws them to engage
W passive: bonus max-health damage when she and her Oathsworn attack the same target
Strong level 1-3 trades with her support
weaknesses: Her attacks can't be cancelled once wound up
Low attack range for a marksman

curve.items: strong – Blade of the Ruined King or Kraken Slayer + Guinsoo's

profile.curveNote: Strongest early; she plays for priority and dragons.

Passive.notes: Hop a short distance after each attack or Q.

Q.notes: Spear; passes on to the next target on kill, carrying Rend stacks.

W.notes: Passive bonus damage with Oathsworn; active sentinel reveals.

E.notes: Rips spears: damage scales per spear, slows.

R.notes: Oathsworn in stasis drawn to her; their launch knocks back enemies.

profile.windowAgainst: When her support is away, or late game. Point-and-click crowd control stops her hops.
